events.name: October 9th, 2026
events.special_rules:
## Highest Temperature

The highest temperature market for Munich on October 9th, 2026 settles on the temperature (°C) officially
recorded for Munich on that calendar date by the designated weather station reporting source
(rounded to whole degrees Celsius). The winning contract is the range or bucket whose label includes that value.
